Subject: Implementation runway and SOW request for Acme Health renewal

Hi Lena / Marco —

Acme Health's annual renewal window is approaching and they want a single-vendor plan for controls automation and evidence collection. We currently have Drata in the pilot and TrustCenter is pitching the add-on coverage for some of their third-party attestation needs. Before we lock a path, legal and the customer have asked for:

- A draft SOW that covers implementation milestones (discovery, connectors, mapping, pilot, full rollout)
- A clear timeline for evidence migration and expected time-in-market
- Pricing tiers (pilot, 6-month rollout, enterprise) and any one-time implementation fees
- Any proposed data retention and encryption language for the SOW (Acme needs KMS integration)

Can you share a short SOW draft and a pricing sheet that separates implementation services from licensing? If you can indicate realistic start dates for a Nov or Dec kickoff that would help.

We're looping in Monica (security ops) and Karthik (compliance/pilot lead) for technical questions.

Thanks —
Ben

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a short-form SOW and a pricing workbook that breaks out implementation work and recurring fees. Quick notes up front:

- We can start discovery as early as Nov 15; discovery -> connectors -> pilot is typically 4–6 weeks depending on connector complexity.
- Evidence migration: small customers (~20 connectors) are typically pilot -> full rollout in 8–10 weeks; for larger orgs (like Acme) assume 12–14 weeks. We recommend a staged rollout by team to avoid noisy alert bursts.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys and can add the required language to the SOW (we'll share options).
- One-time implementation services are listed separately in the pricing workbook; discounts available for 12-mo enterprise commitments.

Next steps: please confirm the scope we should price (pilot = 10 connectors + 2 services; rollout = org-wide) and any special data residency needs. We can do a 30-min kickoff call this week to walk the SOW.

Attachments:
- SOW_draft_TrustCenter.pdf (application/pdf, 74 KB)
- Pricing_Table_TrustCenter.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 28 KB)

Regards,

- Legal will want explicit retention and deletion clauses; please include a redline-friendly section.
- We need certainty around service-level behavior during migration (what is considered migration-related downtime or data loss exposure).
- Evidence mapping: can you provide a CSV export of recommended mappings so we can validate with Acme's security team?

Ben / Karthik — for pricing, I want a breakout that shows: implementation hours by role (PM, engineer, connector specialist), and a list of what is out-of-scope so we don't get surprise SOW amendments.

Lena, can you add a one-page summary that outlines the pilot's success criteria (definition of done) and a risk register entry for typical connector failure modes? That will speed legal review.
